citation.title: Prediction of electron density and pressure profile shapes on NSTX-U using neural networks

topic: Empirical NN prediction of electron density and pressure profile shapes on NSTX/NSTX-U, with an offline-simulated Kalman-filter correction using sparse measurements.
own_question: Can fast NN models map scalar shape/current/volume-average inputs to ne and neTe profile shapes for estimation, control and planning?
actual_method_and_evidence: The model uses PCA-reduced TRANSP-mapped Thomson profiles. It is a 3-member MLP ensemble with Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty. Train/validation/test splits were randomized by shot. A chronological retraining study on NSTX data mimicked online learning. A proof-of-concept Kalman filter on one NSTX-U shot fused NN predictions with 8 simulated low-resolution measurements. This is offline evaluation only. Timing is stated as an expectation based on a related model, not measured here.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Prior work proposed combining fast empirical profile predictions with sparse real-time measurements via a Kalman filter to estimate profiles between or beyond diagnostic updates.
claim_checks.qualification: Electron Thomson profiles on NSTX-U. Offline simulation on a single shot. Not ion/impurity CES. Not deployed.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Shot-wise data splitting was used to avoid overestimating generalization from correlated neighboring time slices.
claim_checks.qualification: Supports a validation-design rationale only, not our specific designs.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Inputs are scalars, including volume-averaged ne and neTe taken from offline profiles. Targets are the current-time profile shape, not a future state. The real-time Thomson system is described as having 17 ms sampling, which is a planned specification rather than a measured arrival time.
validation_if_relevant: Randomized shot split plus a chronological retraining study. The single campaign was reused.
forbidden_inferences: Do not treat this as a demonstration of real-time deployment or measured latency.
Do not extend it to ion temperature, CES, or BES/ECEI.
Do not present it as forecasting future physical temperature.
Do not characterize all prior work as noncausal or electron-only.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Useful as related precedent: an empirical NN combined with a sparse-measurement observer for profile estimation. Its targets, diagnostic and causal setup differ from ours.
